Name: Change Item Effect
Author: tpgml
Description:
[size=3]I am Korean. Using a translator, English can be awkward.

[/size][size=3]Config description

[b]Energy[/b]-"Easy, Regular, Hard"
-Choose the level of energy, strength to recover. 
Restores 75/50/25,30/20/10 in order.
​
[b]Speed[/b]-"Easy, Regular, Hard"
-Choose the level of speed buff for coffee and Jojacola. 
3/2/1 buffs are added in order.
​
[b]Battle[/b]-"Easy, Regular, Hard"
-Choose attack and defense buff levels of slime and bat wings. 
10/5/2 buffs are added in order. The time is limited to two minutes.
​
[b]Time[/b]-"Low, Regular, High, Full"
-Choose the time level for coffee and Jojacola's speed buff. 
(Real Time) 3/6/10/20 minutes in order. Not applicable to attack/defence.
​
[b]Item name (English)[/b]-"true, false"
- Each item can be used (true) or not used (false).

[s]I will upload English and other language translations in the future.
[/s]
We updated it to make all languages available using Fields. (CP ONLY)

Only Korean is still supported for XNB.

The XNB version has the highest version of each number.

Use your mobile, PC for each device.

1.2.0-Fixed the current warning log appearing.
Slime and Bat Wing items were buffed using Includes, not Fields.[/size]
